name: Transformers
description: Research on transformer architectures: self-attention, scaling, efficiency variants, and applications across language, vision, and multimodal tasks.

seminal_papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
seminal_papers.why: Introduced the transformer architecture and self-attention, replacing recurrence and convolution as the backbone of modern sequence models.

seminal_papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
seminal_papers.why: Showed that bidirectional masked-language-model pre-training yields transferable representations, setting the pre-train/fine-tune paradigm for NLP.

seminal_papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
seminal_papers.why: Demonstrated that scaling autoregressive transformers (GPT-3) unlocks in-context few-shot learning without task-specific fine-tuning.

seminal_papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
seminal_papers.why: Brought the transformer to vision (ViT), showing pure attention can match or beat CNNs given enough data.
